title: Frozen executable method manifest for Briakos 2026 same-lineage reproduction
source_priority: repository landing-page metadata only when the PDF is silent

published_method_reconstruction.word_definition: A retained source transliteration item after removal of non-word separators/numeric-only items under the frozen profile.
published_method_reconstruction.sign_tokenization: Split each retained word on literal hyphen '-'.
published_method_reconstruction.distributional_scope: Documents with at least one retained syllabic/transliteration word.

frozen_token_profiles.retain_item_if: string contains at least one ASCII A-Z or asterisk-series label and is not None/newline
frozen_token_profiles.normalization: Unicode NFC only; preserve source spelling, subscripts, plus compounds, asterisk labels and uncertainty marks
frozen_token_profiles.plus_compounds: preserve as one sign component because the thesis explicitly specifies hyphen splitting but does not specify '+' decomposition
for each hyphen component X+Y, retain X as the base label for sign-distribution calculations; preserve the original word for word-frequency reporting
frozen_token_profiles.reason: The published 65-sign catalog may treat commodity/ligature compounds differently, while the thesis does not fully specify this normalization.

frozen_token_profiles.plus_compounds: exclude words containing '+' from sign-distribution calculations while retaining a separate exclusion count
frozen_token_profiles.reason: Tests the alternative interpretation that compound logograms are outside the syllabic 65-sign inventory.

deterministic_metrics.entropy: Shannon entropy base 2 over retained sign-token relative frequencies.
deterministic_metrics.hapax_rate: word types occurring exactly once divided by all retained word types.
deterministic_metrics.mean_word_length: arithmetic mean of number of retained hyphen-delimited sign components per retained word token.
deterministic_metrics.cohens_d: absolute difference of group means divided by pooled sample standard deviation using sample variances (ddof=1).
deterministic_metrics.jsd_bits: Jensen-Shannon divergence base 2 over sign distributions with union vocabulary and zero fill.

register_test.ceremonial_rule: support contains Stone or Vessel, case-insensitive

scribe_test.rule: Always reproduce qualifying-scribe count. Bigram distinctiveness is METHOD_UNDERDETERMINED unless the implementation can be reconstructed without target-guided choices.

formula_test.rule: Compute top-50 structural ranking, but do not invent a nine-item ground-truth list. Evaluation remains METHOD_UNDERDETERMINED until the exact list is recovered from the thesis text/source supplement.

source_method_inconsistency_to_preserve.policy: Do not reconcile the 1448 statement by guessing. Record it as a source-method inconsistency and run formula ranking on the admitted 419-record historical source unless an explicit alternate corpus is identified.
